title: Evaluating Stochastic Rankings with Expected Exposure
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It introduces and evaluates a new metric called 'expected exposure' for stochastic ranking systems, focusing on fairness and diversity in information retrieval and recommendation.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its analysis. The key findings relate to the proposed 'expected exposure' metric, demonstrating its ability to measure and trade off relevance and disparity in rankings, and showing that directly optimizing for this metric improves performance over baseline pointwise and pairwise models.
